# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_SQUEEZE_BREAKOUT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When volatility contracts and the EMA ribbon tightens, a breakout above recent highs on expanding volume captures the ensuing expansion move. This setup identifies low-volatility consolidation phases where the EMA ribbon (9-EMA and 55-EMA) converges, signaling compressed price action, then triggers on a volume-confirmed breakout above the 20-bar high to capture the subsequent volatility expansion.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: When ATR(5) < 0.5×ATR(20) (volatility compression) and the spread between 9‑EMA and 55‑EMA is <0.1% of price (ribbon tight), and price closes above the highest high of the prior 20 bars on volume >2× the 20‑bar average volume, go long at the close. Exit shape: Stop at the lowest low of the prior 20 bars (structure invalidation); target at 2× risk or trail using a chandelier exit set at 20% below the highest close since entry. Regime hint: Ideal when VIX < 22 and time 10:00‑14:00, avoiding the first and last 30 minutes where opening‑range noise dominates.
